notes.title: Battle Room Beta First major update "Fog Feed"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903319/096c74377bbe24a2f6c43c791e176610248e3d33.gif[/img]
[previewyoutube=W2Bmb-DZNqQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Battle Room Beta[/b] Steam version v0.1.1.0
We are implementing the first major update of Battle Room Beta. You may have seen the colorful fog covering our maps. This fog actually serves as an indicator. This system, which we call Fog Feed, is responsible for announcing all in-game news with color changes, texts and effects. Its biggest feature is to announce the achievements (Double Kill, etc.) achieved by the players during the match in a spectacular way so that everyone can see it. Of course, in the future, and most likely in the full version, it will turn into a feature where you can express your personality with completely customize effects, colors and text.
Apart from these, a few changes and bugfixes were also made in this version.

===

▼A major bug fixed
-Fixed a bug where the fatal error that occurred at the end of all matches.
▼Gameplay Updates
-The spread of the rifle when firing has been changed.
-Made a few changes to the Game Room map.

===

As a small indie team, we are taking small and determined steps to make Battle Room Beta more playable, more enjoyable and smoother every day. As always, your observations and questions are our greatest help. Keep in touch with us.

notes.title: Battle Room Beta v0.1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[b]Battle Room Beta[/b] Steam version v0.1.0.3

Patch Notes:

===

▼UI Fix
- Fixed a bug where the sniper scope would remain when changing weapons while it was on the scope.

▼Gameplay Updates
- Ranges of weapons have been changed.
- Headshot damage multiplier on weapons increased.
- The number of ammunition in weapons has been increased.
- Reduced regeneration time for weapon spawners.


===

We will continue to make gameplay improvements and bug fixes, as well as adding new features in the future. As always, it is very precious for us to become a part of Battle Room with your feedback.

notes.title: Battle Room Beta version update
notes.content:
[b]Battle Room Beta[/b] Steam version v0.1.0.1

Patch Notes:

===

▼UI Fixes
-Fixed a bug where player names overflowing from the scoreboard.
-Fixed a bug where the bomb icon corrupted the ammo icons.
-Fixed an issue where some languages appeared in English in the menus in options.
-Fixed an bug where the target sensitivity setting in the controllers menu did not work.

▼Audio Fix
-Fixed a bug where the hosting player heard the damage sounds of all players (which was very annoying)


▼Bots
-Fixed an issue where bots get stuck in some parts of the maps.

===

Although this update does not solve all the problems of the game, we hope it will have a positive impact on your entertainment. Our work on major issues continues. Thanks to your contributions, it becomes easier for us to identify and solve issues.
